open_questions: Someone asks the bank to leave out or hide a fact from a bank record, note or internal recipient. A caller protecting their own unrelated data (masking fields, not sending personal details) does not count.
The fact matters for the record's purpose (for example a repayable obligation for a credit decision). False if it is an unrelated private detail or the correction of a wrong entry.
